title: Comet at the Caravanserai
description: A single striking 16:10 landscape wallpaper set at dusk beside a historically grounded medieval caravanserai on a high desert trade route. A small stone astronomical platform, weathered wooden instruments, tethered pack horses, and a distant fortified hospice establish the setting with reverence and realism. In the lower-right foreground, Space Ghost appears as an unmistakable out-of-place visitor—muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, red power bands—standing stiffly and respectfully while holding an oversized brass astrolabe as though on official duty. A few robed scholars quietly continue their star measurements nearby, treating him as an awkward but harmless colleague. A comet crosses the open sky, guiding the composition toward the empty upper-left region reserved for desktop widgets. The humor comes only from his solemn scientific posture and conspicuous costume; no sacred figures, devotional objects, worship, lettering, or explanatory text.
prompt:
Create exactly one striking 16:10 landscape desktop wallpaper, preferably 2560x1600, containing a Space Ghost cameo. Space Ghost is the recognizable animated superhero: muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, red power bands. The humour is affectionate and understated; he is an out-of-place visitor who takes the occasion completely seriously. Make the visual joke readable without any explanatory text.

The viewer is a devout Christian who loves history, chivalry and the medieval Crusades. Christian subjects, wherever they appear, are depicted straight, reverently and accurately, and are never the butt of the joke. Strict limits, which override anything else in this request: never depict Space Ghost or his companions as Christ, God, the Holy Spirit, an angel, a saint, the Virgin Mary or any holy person; never give them a halo, nimbus, aureole, or any devotional attribute; never place them as the object of veneration, prayer or worship; never show them as clergy performing a sacrament or blessing. Never parody scripture, the crucifixion, the Mass, the Eucharist, baptism, prayer or any act of worship. Altars, crucifixes, icons, relics and the consecrated elements are never props or punchlines. Where a church, monastery, cathedral or sacred art appears, render it with genuine reverence and let the humour come only from Space Ghost being somewhere he plainly does not belong, behaving respectfully.

Follow the supplied medium and treatment exactly and do not default to oil painting unless the request asks for one. Preserve a spacious, quieter upper edge for a desktop panel and leave at least one calm region for desktop widgets. If a theme is supplied, follow its palette throughout; otherwise choose colours that suit the subject naturally. No user interface, words, lettering, logos, watermarks or picture frames. Deliver the actual raster image using built-in native image generation; do not substitute code, SVG or a text description.

Theme: Comet at the Caravanserai. Textured egg-tempera and mineral-pigment illustration on dark vellum, combining precise medieval astronomical diagramming with softly weathered gouache, restrained hatching, and subtly luminous night atmosphere. The mood is contemplative, chivalric, quietly humorous, and historically grounded. Use a nontraditional palette of deep blue-green shadow, parchment-ivory highlights, oxidized coral, muted brass, and sparse icy turquoise accents. Keep forms crisp enough for desktop viewing, with broad atmospheric negative space and a calm, nearly unmarked upper edge; no lettering, borders, logos, or decorative UI.
